 Print RSSB will release the Rajasthan CET Senior Secondary Level Admit Card 2026 on November 26. The examination is scheduled for December 1 to 3 in two shifts. (Photo credit- Magnific+ RSSB Logo -rssb.rajasthan.gov.in) The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has announced the release date for the Rajasthan CET 12th Level admit card 2026. According to the official notice issued on November 19, 2026, candidates appearing for the Common Eligibility Test (Senior Secondary Level) will be able to download their provisional e-admit cards from November 26, 2026. The examination is scheduled to be held on December 1, 2, and 3 in two shifts each day. Candidates who have registered for the examination will be able to access their hall tickets through the official recruitment portal using their login credentials. The board has also announced the date for checking the allotted examination district, giving candidates an opportunity to check their examination location ahead of the test. The RSSB will activate the Rajasthan CET 12th Level Admit Card 2026 download link on November 26. Candidates will be able to access their provisional hall tickets through the recruitment portal at recruitment.rajasthan.gov.in. The admit cards will not be dispatched separately to candidates. Applicants must download their hall tickets online using their SSO ID or the prescribed login details. Join conversation

 Candidates should download the admit card as soon as the link becomes active and verify all the information mentioned on it. They should also retain a printed copy of the hall ticket for the examination. Rajasthan CET 12th Level admit card 2026: Steps to download hall ticket
 Candidates can follow the steps elucidated here to download the Rajasthan CET 12th Level admit card 2026 from the official website: Visit the official recruitment portal at recruitment.rajasthan.gov.in.
 On the homepage, navigate to the admit card download section.
 Click on the 'Get Admit Card' option.
 Select the RSSB CET 12th Level examination.
 Enter the required login credentials, including the application number and date of birth, wherever prompted.
 Submit the details to access the admit card.
 Download the provisional e-admit card and check the information mentioned on it.
 Take a printout of the hall ticket for future reference and examination-day requirements.
 Rajasthan CET 12th Level admit card 2026: Details mentioned
 The admit card is an important examination document containing the candidate's identification and examination-related information. After downloading the hall ticket, candidates should verify the following details: Candidate's name and roll number
 Application number
 Examination date and shift
 Examination centre name and address
 Candidate's photograph and signature
 Other examination-related instructions
